name: axiomancer-mobile-hermes-ui-playtest
description: Hermes-native UI playthrough plan for Axiomancer Mobile, designed to produce evidence-rich reports for Tobin's systems judgment.

server.command: CI=1 EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npx expo start --web --port 18081 --host localhost

paths.name: Golden encounter path
paths.goal: From first WILDS load, travel to an encounter, enter combat, resolve at least one full round, then start the next round.

paths.name: Failure and retreat path
paths.goal: Probe FLEE, invalid choices, low-information states, and any visible defeat/retreat consequences without inventing outcomes not observed.

paths.name: Tab literacy path
paths.goal: Visit WILDS, SELF, MEMOIR, and SATCHEL as a first-time player and judge whether each tab explains what can be done there.
minimumEvidence: one action or probe per tab when available
notes on terminology, affordance clarity, and dead surfaces

paths.name: Edge probes
paths.goal: Tap things that look tappable, use keyboard navigation where practical, scroll long surfaces, and look for dead ends, hidden state, or missing feedback.
minimumEvidence: any no-op tap called out explicitly

paths.name: Mechanics-to-UI fidelity path
paths.goal: Compare visible HP, stance, action, reward, mercy check, inventory, and aftermath information against what the UI claims the mechanics are doing.
minimumEvidence: before/after values for any changed stat
battle log text compared with visible panels
any mismatch between surfaces documented as fidelity risk
